blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) and the northeasterly wind flow will continue to bring rains over several areas in the country until Thursday, Oct. 8, the state weather bureau said. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported in its 4 p.m. weather advisory that the ITCZ, or the convergence of winds from the northern and southern hemispheres, will affect Mindanao, Negros Island Region, Central Visayas, Palawan, and Southern Leyte.
